inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped query applies a named window to a nested aggregate, using SUM(SUM(value)) OVER a shared window to expose a total across grouped rows.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a team score summary. Fixed match scores are grouped by team, SUM(score) computes each team total, and SUM(SUM(score)) OVER all_scores reuses a named empty window to expose the global score total on every grouped row. The source tables, identifiers, and values are not copied.

fixture_notes: Team 10 totals 13 points and team 20 totals 10 points; every grouped row must expose the global total of 23 through the nested aggregate window.
determinism_notes: Team IDs, match IDs, score values, grouping, named empty-window definition, and final ordering are fixed; the report is read-only with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE team_match_scores (match_id INT PRIMARY KEY, team_id INT NOT NULL, score INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT team_id, SUM(score) AS team_total, SUM(SUM(score)) OVER all_scores AS global_total FROM team_match_scores GROUP BY team_id WINDOW all_scores AS () ORDER BY team_id
